_frame: NIR in the RESID frame. Chance is 0.50.
_supports_are_not_comparable: Each column is scored on its own support. A mark in one column may not be set beside a mark in another; the reference itself differs (0.854 on n=1394, 0.857 on n=1192, and it is not drawn on n=218).
_intervals: No interval is drawn. re_v3.json reports bootstrap intervals on DIFFERENCES between arms (means/vs_baselines/<arm>/ci_two_way), not on the level of a single arm, so a bar on a dot here would have no source. The differences are tabulated in tab:lookup.

label_lifts_value_units._why: all four sit within 0.04 of the chance rule; generic's label sat at exactly 0.500 and the rule struck through it. Lifts are label positions only; every dot is at its own value.

horizontal_dodge_cm._why: control_copy/random/generic are 0.005 and 0.001 apart, which is 0.8mm and 0.16mm at this scale against a 1.0mm dot. Horizontal position carries no meaning.

drug_lookup_1.source: means/drug_lookup_1 (exists only on this support; recomputed from records over the 1192 conditions = 0.8217279)

column_3_moa_support.n_source: means/vs_baselines/moa_lookup/n; equals the number of records carrying a moa_lookup value

model.source: mean of records[].model over the 218 records that carry a moa_lookup value

_CORRECTION.what_that_number_is: means/common_support/model, i.e. the model's value on the n=1192 support, reused on the n=218 support
_CORRECTION.why_it_is_wrong: It put the model BELOW moa_lookup, i.e. the wrong sign for a gap the thesis states as +0.0436. The model's mean on this support is 0.595575.
_CORRECTION.claim_unchanged: means/vs_baselines/moa_lookup/ci_two_way spans zero, so moa_lookup is still 'not separated from the model'.

_numbers_also_stated_in_the_thesis_text._status: every drawn mark matches the text except the column-3 model mark, which the text does not state; see _CORRECTION.
